messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "two weeks before conception and through first trimester"
set: ["two weeks before conception and through first trimester", "effective contraception for two weeks after final dose", "digoxin needs care for two separate reasons", "safety and efficacy beyond 16 weeks of therapy have not been established", "breathing problems may occur when first starting", "starting levothyroxine first can trigger adrenal crisis", "can cause injury or death to the unborn baby if used during second or third trimester", "use within 7 days before MAO inhibitor", "problems may occur when you first start taking tramadol", "ask doctor before use if pregnant or breastfeeding", "efficacy beyond 8 weeks has not been systematically studied", "symptoms may improve before infection is completely cleared", "risk is particularly high in the first few months of treatment", "heartburn is often confused with the first symptoms of a heart attack", "some young people may have thoughts about suicide when first taking antidepressant", "includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
